I'll read `README.md` and return only its first heading.# Sage

notes: This is the golden case for contract rule 4. All three tool frames keep kind toolCall under one external id, varying only lifecycle and toolState.
Rule 4 now holds: every adapter emits toolCall for a tool's whole life, so the three frames land on one durable item instead of a toolCall plus a separate toolUpdateResult.
The wire kind is read, which maps 1:1 onto ToolCategory::Read. Categories are never collapsed into a coarser file bucket.
cursor-agent tool call ids embed a newline. The contract must tolerate that without splitting the identity.

ACP has no message end, so the translator closes output itself: answer text after an untagged thought completes that thought block (a later thought opens the next block's item), and the completed prompt response completes the turn's still-open text, thought and plan items before the turn terminal.
